name: LongCat-AudioDiT (Meituan)
blurb: New quality leader for zero-shot voice cloning. The official Seed benchmark puts both LongCat sizes above Qwen3-TTS, IndexTTS-2, MOSS-TTS and F5-TTS for speaker similarity.

models.name: 1B — recommended · SOTA clone similarity · 8 GB target

badge.tip: High VRAM: the 3.5B flagship may run out of memory on this 8 GB GPU. Use the 1B model for normal work.

params.label: Quality steps
params.help: 16 is the official quality default. More steps are slower and usually give diminishing returns.

params.label: Voice guidance
params.help: How strongly the result follows the text and voice prompt. 4.0 is the official default.

params.label: Seed (0 = random)
params.help: Fix a seed to reproduce a take you liked.

params.label: Pitch (semitones)
params.help: Shift pitch while preserving vocal character. ±2–4 stays most natural.

params.label: Formant / character
params.help: Change apparent vocal-tract size independently of pitch.

params.label: Intonation range
params.help: 0 is monotone, 1 keeps the generated performance, 1.5+ exaggerates pitch movement.

params.label: Clarity
params.help: Speech EQ: reduce mud and add presence/air.

params.label: Loudness normalize (0/1)
params.help: Match takes to a consistent -18 LUFS.
